dolt_writer_component.scope: B0 Dolt conditional writer (docs/writfold/storage-backend.md#the-dolt-conditional-writer). One dolt sql process runs one explicit transaction: a guard checks that main and HEAD are the expected-old commit, the working set is clean and wf_reader_meta is exactly the writer's realm row; then hex-literal row changes, a closure guard, DOLT_COMMIT and the wf-retained root. Atomic because the dolt process holds the database's exclusive native lock for its lifetime (a second process is read-only; observed on 2.6.1) and DOLT_COMMIT moves head and working set in one root update. Exclusive recorded writer lease (coordination/writer.lock plus writer.claim). Every write needs a DoltWriteApproval built from a strictly verified SuppliedDoltAuthorization whose base is the expected-old pin. Outcomes come from probes under the same coordination lease; a killed or timed-out write is Unknown, never retried, and read-only observe resolves it by the request digest in the commit message. Not DINT02 publication, release closure or Git CAS.

dolt_publication_model.scope: spec/DoltPublication.tla: TLC model of the DINT02 first-slice publication order (docs/writfold/dolt-integration.md#model). publish (Git expected-old check, retained candidate blob, Dolt conditional commit that may be killed between DOLT_COMMIT and its retention branch, head retention, read-back and prepared commit, Git expected-old CAS), observe as a transcription of writfold_core::publication::resolve over the facts the Rust observed gathers, complete with Git steps only, a direct Dolt writer outside the leases, and a kill between any two steps of publish and complete. One invocation holds both leases at a time. Invariants: no double publication; visibility only via a completed CAS; a published release names exactly the commit its own Dolt write made, retained, with its candidate blob retained; observe agrees with ground truth and refuses Diverged only after a direct write moved the head past an interrupted attempt; an Interrupted attempt satisfies every guard of the Git-only completion and no accepted invocation is refused after its first write; complete never issues a Dolt write; an attempt whose Dolt write never happened leaves the approval unspent; a published approval is never accepted again. Bounded model evidence of the documented order only: not a refinement of the Rust, no TLAPS proof, no gate receipt, not M11/V15, WF10/WF11/WF14 or DINT02.
